principles: user supplied code is treated as untrusted text and is never executed by the evaluator
embedded prompt instructions inside code/comments/strings are ignored
multiple model families are preferred to reduce correlated review blind spots
creative review encourages divergent engineering alternatives but does not remove safety, law, provider policy, privacy, or authority boundaries
OPENROUTER_API_KEY is runtime-only and must never be persisted in source, receipts, prompts, logs, or portable artifacts
provider routing requests data_collection=deny and zdr=true by default
model outputs remain PROPOSAL_ONLY until independently validated
live provider maturity requires exact provider response, resolved-model identity, usage/cost where supplied, source hash, and semantic readback
source or CI success never substitutes for provider connectivity proof
truth_boundary: This manifest registers the evaluator design and source contract only. LIVE_OPENROUTER_CODE_EVALUATION is not proven until the provider canary runs with an authorised runtime credential and its receipt is independently read back.
